title: Sculktech
description: Adding Sculk Machinery And Lethal Blocks!
body:
# Sculktech
Is a mod that aims to add a high quality blocks, machinery ~~and ways of killing enemies~~ inspired by The Deep Dark's redstone example builds, and expanding on them!

Current features include:
- Transmitters - redstone-powerable blocks, which are the heart of the Sculktech machinery, as it creates Vibrational Signal
- Recievers - blocks which pick up the vibrations and power all Sculktech machinery that they touch
- Vibration Lamps - fragile blocks triggered by Vibrational Signal that emit light when turned on
- A new Music Disc "Offering" by Kasqadia
